scope: Contributor-owned synthetic ThreeWayVelocityMux and SequencedMotionMux; no ROS2/DDS or hardware.
problem: claim_transit assigned the candidate UUID and cleared ACTIVE/idle history before _arm checked existing ownership. A second request during a pending transit (or after ACTIVE became idle) was rejected but erased the first lease's UUID and evidence. Its valid ACTIVE update then caused a spurious stop, or its valid terminal release failed.
correction: Commit the candidate UUID and reset its history only after the existing _arm admission succeeds. Remove the former exception rollback that overwrote a current lease. No new check, gate, timer, interface or worker.
